title: Anzu Prebid Adapter Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the Anzu Prebid adapter

zone.description: Which Anzu bid endpoint to call: "zone1" or "zone2"

queryString.description: Query string for the chosen zone's endpoint, e.g. "pid=123" for zone1 or "c=rtb&m=req&key=abc" for zone2. Only characters valid in a URL query; no '#', ';' or spaces
